svg.title: Boundary outline primitive and full port node
svg.desc: On the left, an outline primitive without a direction indicator straddles the boundary of a wheel part usage. On the right, a rounded full node contains the keyword port and hub : Mount.
svg.metadata: Original educational redraw based on OMG SysML 2.0 formal/2026-03-02; https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=243. Not an official figure or parser-validation result.

a.text: Original illustrative redraw · Official notation source
